title: 第7章 拳定分寸十二桥手第8章 激烈的商业竞争
content_zh:
;;
林青回头，只见师傅洪元，正站在不远处，目光炯炯地看着自己。
“根骨中平，却能在十天之内将铁线拳练至纯熟，只比王诚差了两天。”
“这份毅力，倒是不错。”
林青看了一眼仍在角落中，沉默练拳的王诚，内心略微惊诧。
这哥们，竟还早自己两天入门，真是太卷了。
洪元走上前，捏了捏林青的手臂，感受着那绷紧的筋肉和隐隐流动的气血，微微颔首。
“看来你平日没少下苦功。”
能得到洪元的认可，林青心中也是一喜：“多谢师傅夸奖，弟子资质鲁钝，唯有勤能补拙。”
洪元眼中闪过赞赏，随即对旁边一名弟子吩咐道：“不等了，去把这次新入门的弟子，都叫到前院来。”
“是，师傅。”那弟子恭敬应答。
不多时，连同林青在内的八名新弟子，齐聚前院练武场。
洪元负手立于众人面前，目光扫过一张张年轻的面孔，朗声开口。
“尔等入门已有些时日，根基稍固。”
“今日，便传尔等铁线拳之打法——十二桥手！”
“看好了，老夫只传这一次。”
洪元声若洪钟，身形陡然一动！
只见他脚踏中宫，双拳如蛟龙出海，时而施展刚桥硬打硬进，时而施展柔桥缠丝绞杀。
直桥直杀，分桥分劈，定桥贯势，寸桥凝指。
动作大开大合，刚猛暴烈。

手臂挥舞间，那数十铁环哗啦作响，如同疾风骤雨，带起道道凌厉的劲风，刮得人面皮生疼！
“刚柔逼直分定寸，提留运制订乾坤。”
“十二桥手，乃我铁线拳攻防之核心！”
“拳分定寸，以筋催劲，力透指骨，刚猛无铸。”
洪元一边演练，一边讲解发力要领。
他招式并不繁复。
但每一次出手，都蕴含着极强的破坏力，劲风呼啸，让人望之色变。
演练至酣处，洪元猛地一声暴喝，如同平地惊雷炸响。
他身形一矮，右掌闪电般拍向场边半人高黑色顽石。
“嘭！”
一声沉闷的巨响声，直接炸开。
众人只觉脚下地面，也微微一震。
凝神看去，无不骇然变色。
只见那块坚硬无比的黑石，直接被洪元一掌拍得碎裂开来，泥尘簌簌落下，连带着地面泥土，都陡然下沉三寸。
而洪元已然收掌而立，气息平稳。
似乎刚才那石破天惊的一击，并非他所为。
“若那是人的话，一掌下去不得……”
一名新弟子瞠目结舌，喃喃自语。
content_en:
;;
Lin Qing turned around and saw her master, Hong Yuan, standing not far away, looking at her with bright eyes.
"My bones are average, but I can master Iron Wire Fist within ten days. I'm only two days behind Wang Cheng."
"This perseverance is quite good."
Lin Qing glanced at Wang Cheng, who was still practicing boxing silently in the corner, feeling slightly surprised.
This guy actually got started two days earlier. It’s really weird.
Hong Yuan stepped forward, squeezed Lin Qing's arm, felt the tense muscles and the faint flowing blood, and nodded slightly.
"It seems that you work hard every day."
Lin Qing was overjoyed to be recognized by Hong Yuan: "Thank you, master, for the compliment. If a disciple is slow in qualifications, only hard work can make up for it."
Appreciation flashed in Hong Yuan's eyes, and he immediately ordered a disciple next to him: "No wait, go and call all the new disciples this time to the front yard."
"Yes, Master." The disciple responded respectfully.
Not long after, eight new disciples, including Lin Qing, gathered in the martial arts training ground in the front yard.
Hong Yuan stood in front of everyone with his hands behind his hands, glanced at the young faces, and spoke loudly.
"It has been some time since you started, and your foundation is somewhat solid."
"Today, I will teach you the iron fist technique - Twelve Bridge Hands!"
"Watch it, I will only pass it on this once."
Hong Yuan's voice was like a bell, and his figure suddenly moved!
I saw him with his feet on the middle palace, his fists like dragons rising out of the sea, sometimes using a hard bridge to hit hard, and sometimes using a soft bridge to wrap around silk to strangle.
Straight bridge to kill directly, split bridge to split, fixed bridge to maintain momentum, inch bridge to freeze fingers.
The movements are wide open and close, fierce and violent.
As he waved his arms, the dozens of iron rings rattled like a sudden storm, bringing up strong winds that made people's faces hurt!
"Hardness and softness force each other to determine the right direction, and the destiny is determined to determine the universe."
"The Twelve Bridge Hands are the core of my iron fist's offense and defense!"
"The fist is measured and measured, the muscles are used to stimulate the energy, the force penetrates the finger bones, and it is strong and strong without casting."
Hong Yuan explained the key points of exerting force while practicing.
His moves are not complicated.
But every time he takes action, it contains extremely strong destructive power, and the strong wind roars, making people look pale.
When the exercise reached its climax, Hong Yuan let out a loud roar, which was like thunder on the ground.
He dwarfed and struck the black stone about half a man high on the sidelines with his right palm like lightning.
"Bang!"
There was a dull loud noise and it exploded.
Everyone felt the ground beneath their feet shaking slightly.
Looking at it carefully, everyone changed their color in shock.
I saw that the extremely hard black stone was directly shattered by Hong Yuan's palm. The mud and dust fell, and the soil on the ground suddenly sank three inches.
But Hong Yuan had already closed his palms and stood up, breathing calmly.
It seemed that the earth-shattering blow just now was not caused by him.
"If it were a human being, it wouldn't be possible to hit it with one palm..."
A new disciple was dumbfounded and muttered to himself.
